description: The platformer module (packages/core/docs/genre-mechanics.md §4): levels over a world’s own places, goals at characters’ homes and workplaces, checkpoints, respawns and stars. Each kb opens with packages/core/src/platformer/platformer-predicates.ts verbatim and then packages/core/src/prolog/mechanics/traversal-predicates.ts verbatim, because whether a goal can be reached is traversal’s reachable/3; regenerate with npm run genre-mechanics-corpus. Stars are integer arithmetic: within par is 3, within half as much again (2·Cost ≤ 3·Par) is 2, else 1. World cases run over conformance/genre-mechanics/thistlecombe.world-slice.json, a slice of a real Insimul world (the Unity closing-wave export of Thistlecombe) cut by npm run genre-world-slice; their facts are what core’s generators produce from it and their expectations are what core’s TypeScript resolution says.

cases.name: a-bare-kb-has-no-level-and-does-not-raise
kb: platformer_max([X | T], M) :- T \== [], platformer_max(T, M0), ( X >= M0 -> M = X ; M = M0 ).
platformer_unlocked(R, L) :- nonvar(R), platformer_level(L, N), N > 1, P is N - 1, platformer_level(Prev, P), platformer_cleared(R, Prev, _).
platformer_goal_reachable(R, L) :- nonvar(R), platformer_level_start(L, S), platformer_level_goal(L, G), \+ \+ reachable(R, S, G).
platformer_checkpoint_missed(R, L, N) :- platformer_level_checkpoint(L, _, N), \+ platformer_checkpoint_reached(R, L, N).
platformer_level_complete(R, L) :- nonvar(R), platformer_running(R, L), platformer_level_goal(L, G), at_location(R, G), \+ platformer_checkpoint_missed(R, L, _).

platformer_respawn(R, L, Place) :- nonvar(R), platformer_running(R, L), findall(N, platformer_checkpoint_reached(R, L, N), Ns), Ns \== [], !, platformer_max(Ns, Max), platformer_level_checkpoint(L, Place, Max).
platformer_respawn(R, L, Place) :- nonvar(R), platformer_running(R, L), platformer_level_start(L, Place).
platformer_stars_for(L, Cost, 3) :- platformer_level_par(L, Par), Cost =< Par, !.
platformer_stars_for(L, Cost, 2) :- platformer_level_par(L, Par), 2 * Cost =< 3 * Par, !.
platformer_run_stars(R, L, Stars) :- platformer_level_complete(R, L), platformer_run_cost(R, L, Cost), platformer_stars_for(L, Cost, Stars).
traversal_goal_met(A, Goal) :- Goal =.. [F, _ | Rest], Bound =.. [F, A | Rest], call(Bound).
can_traverse(A, From, To) :- traversal_link(From, To, Mode), \+ traversal_blocked(From, To), movement_mode(A, Mode), \+ (traversal_requires(From, To, Goal), \+ traversal_goal_met(A, Goal)).
reachable(A, From, To) :- reachable_via(A, From, To, [From]).
reachable_via(A, From, To, _) :- can_traverse(A, From, To).
reachable_via(A, From, To, Seen) :- can_traverse(A, From, Mid), \+ traversal_member(Mid, Seen), reachable_via(A, Mid, To, [Mid | Seen]).
riding_mode(A, Mode) :- vehicle_driver(V, A), vehicle_mode(V, Mode).
can_board(A, V) :- vehicle_mode(V, _), at_location(V, L), at_location(A, L), \+ vehicle_occupant(V, A).
can_drive(A, V) :- vehicle_occupant(V, A), \+ (vehicle_driver(V, Other), Other \== A).
vehicle_not_owned_by(A, V) :- vehicle_owner(V, Owner), Owner \== A.
can_fast_travel(A, Dest) :- location_discovered(Dest), at_location(A, Here), Here \== Dest, reachable(A, Here, Dest).
